doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Walter Allen's article 'The King's Saxophone' from Paul's notebook
summary: Russell recalls Walter Allen publishing material from Paul's book and promises a copy.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Some of this book I believe did you once loan this to Walter Allen? Yeah, I did. And I think he published that in an article, some of it in the record changer. I guess you got that paper that time. Wow. Called the King's Saxophone, remember that article.
I didn't get it. You didn't see it. I have it. You don't have it now.
We have it in Tulane. I'll bring the copy down and let you do that sometime.
I certainly would like to see that.
Yeah. Which he tells about all those times when they didn't get paid hardly anything. Some nights and now they...
